facts.text: Audrey took her dogs to the pet salon on Friday, and they were excited and wagging their tails.

evidence.quote: Last Friday I took my fur kids to the pet salon - they were so psyched and their tails were wagging like crazy!
Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places.

facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of her dogs at the pet salon, showing them with shiny coats and appearing calm.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places.
Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places.

facts.text: Audrey expressed satisfaction with her dogs' behavior at the pet salon and humorously referred to herself as a 'doggy mom'.

evidence.quote: Thanks! It means a lot to see them happy and settled in new places. I guess I'm doing a good job as a doggy mom then, haha!

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that he and his partner recently adopted a dog named Scout and shared a photo of the dog being fed hay in a barn.

evidence.quote: So guess what, I can't help myself but to adopt another dog the other day. Here's a photo of the doggo!
It took us a while to decide, but we ended up going with 'Scout' for our pup - it seemed perfect for their adventurous spirit.
